concept.title: Registering the X-Author Add-in
concept.shortdesc: In rare cases, the X-Author Designer or X-Author for Excel tabs are not properly installed

conbody.p: In rare cases, the X-Author Designer or X-Author for Excel tabs are not properly installed and, therefore, are not visible in your Microsoft Excel ribbon menu. If this occurs, you must manually register the X-Author add-in to add it to the Excel ribbon.
